description: Defines the SubscriptionApiService class implementing subscription-related API calls, managing in-progress operations, and handling server interactions for subscription invites and Apple IAP confirmation.

classes.name: SubscriptionApiService
classes.description: Implements subscription API interactions, manages operation states, and handles invite and Apple IAP confirmation processes.

methods.name: listInvites
methods.description: Retrieves the list of subscription invites, handling in-progress state and errors.

methods.name: cancelInvite
methods.description: Cancels a specific invite identified by inviteUuid, with in-progress state management.

methods.name: invite
methods.description: Sends an invite to a specified email address, managing operation state.

methods.name: acceptInvite
methods.description: Accepts a subscription invite by UUID, with in-progress handling.

methods.name: confirmAppleIAP
methods.description: Confirms Apple IAP purchase with provided parameters, managing operation state.
